name: What is the typical cost range for a laundry room addition?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for a laundry room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a laundry room addition varies widely based on factors such as size, chosen materials, necessary utility extensions, and appliance selection. A basic conversion of an existing space might start from $15,000, while a larger, custom-built addition with high-end finishes and new plumbing/electrical lines could range from $30,000 to $70,000+. This estimate generally covers design, permits, construction, and basic installations, but appliance costs are usually separate. We provide detailed estimates after an initial site visit and design consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Typical costs for laundry room additions range from $15,000 for basic conversions to $30,000-$70,000+ for new custom additions. Cost depends on size, materials, and utility work.
